Envato has launched MonoDesk, a workspace for creative freelancers and small studios with a new focus on its built-in AI assistant.

> MonoDesk’s AI assistant can check if a client wants extra work and automatically draft a reply with a price.

> Once a client accepts a proposal,
posts.quoted: Running a creative business is hard enough without the 11pm “quick add before launch” emails. Proposals, projects, client sign-off and the agreed scope, all in one calm place. So when the late request lands, you already know what was agreed. Less admin. More creative flow.
